body.objective: Students will be able to use opinion expressions.
successCriteria: I can express and justify opinions
I can agree and disagree politely
I can link ideas with connectors (cependant, par contre, donc, en plus)
body.hook: Should school start at 10 a.m.? Should phones be banned in class? In French, a strong opinion isn't enough. You need to support it, admit the other side and connect your ideas so others follow your argument.

vocabulary.term: je suis d'accord / je ne suis pas d'accord

study.title: Le grand débat
study.question: How do I build and defend an opinion in French?
study.passage:
Opinion: À mon avis, ... / Je pense que ... / Je crois que ... / Selon moi, ...
Justify: parce que ..., car ..., par exemple ...
Agree: Je suis d'accord avec toi. Tu as raison. C'est vrai.
Disagree politely: Je ne suis pas d'accord parce que ... Je comprends ton point de vue, mais ... Tu as raison, cependant ...
Connectors: d'abord (first), en plus (in addition), par contre (on the other hand), cependant (however), donc (therefore), en conclusion.
Débat modèle : « Les téléphones devraient être interdits en classe. »
Malik : À mon avis, il faut interdire les téléphones en classe parce qu'ils sont une distraction. En plus, certains élèves trichent avec leur téléphone.
Sofia : Je comprends ton point de vue, mais je ne suis pas d'accord. Les téléphones sont utiles pour la recherche et les dictionnaires. Par contre, on devrait les utiliser seulement quand le prof le permet.
Malik : C'est vrai, cependant beaucoup d'élèves ne respectent pas les règles.
Sofia : Donc, il faut des règles claires, pas une interdiction totale !
Task: Choose a debate topic, prepare three arguments and one counter-argument, then debate in pairs.
study.source: Original model debate written for this lesson.
steps: Prepare and hold your own debate
discussion: Who made the stronger argument, Malik or Sofia? Why?
How does "Je comprends ton point de vue, mais..." change the tone?
Which connectors made the debate easier to follow?
Can you change your mind during a debate?
study.product: Hold a three-minute debate with a partner and then write a 150-word opinion paragraph using at least five connectors and a counter-argument.

examples.title: Justify
examples.problem: Say "In my opinion, school should start later because we are tired."
examples.answer: À mon avis, l'école devrait commencer plus tard parce que nous sommes fatigués.
examples.explore: Add a second argument with en plus.

examples.title: Polite disagreement
examples.answer: Je comprends ton point de vue, mais les devoirs nous aident à pratiquer.
examples.explore: What other phrase could you use?

examples.title: Connector
examples.problem: Join: "Phones are useful. They are distracting."
examples.answer: Les téléphones sont utiles; cependant, ils sont distrayants.

examples.title: Conclusion
examples.answer: En conclusion, il faut des règles claires pour les téléphones.

practice.q: Give two ways to justify an opinion.

practice.a: Je comprends ton point de vue, mais...
Phones should be banned in class.
Clear rules, not a total ban.

practice.q: Translate: On the other hand, phones help with research.
practice.a: Par contre, les téléphones aident pour la recherche.

practice.q: Give two opinion starters besides à mon avis.
practice.a: Je pense que, je crois que, selon moi.

practice.q: Why include a counter-argument in your writing?
practice.a: It shows you considered other views and makes your argument stronger.

practice.q: Explain the difference between "par contre" and "en plus."
practice.a: Par contre contrasts; en plus adds.

practice.q: Write a sentence agreeing partly, then disagreeing.
Why are connectors important in an argument?
practice.a: They show how ideas relate and make it easy to follow.

misconceptions: Disagreeing rudely ("Tu as tort!") instead of politely
exitTicket: Write an opinion sentence with a reason.
Use two different connectors in sentences.

options: D) Je comprends ton point de vue, mais...
items.answer: D) Je comprends ton point de vue, mais...

items.q: Sofia thinks phones are useful for
Including a counter-argument makes your writing
The best connector to add a second argument is

options: D) clear rules, not a total ban
items.answer: D) clear rules, not a total ban

items.q: Translate "Je pense que l'école est importante."
Write an opinion with two reasons using en plus.

items.answer: Malik: ban phones; Sofia: clear rules, not a ban.

items.q: Give three connectors and their meanings.
Explain why connectors make arguments stronger.
items.answer: They show logical relationships between ideas.

items.q: Write a short opinion paragraph with a counter-argument.
